label: final-local-host
fixture: 20 synthetic direct-input order rows in a newly created browser profile. Real workspace.html, workspace.js, SmartInput and customer-master are used without source replacement. No authentication session, personal profile, production database, external command or owner transmission is used.

methodology.warmup: One unrecorded real roundtrip, with the last synthetic quantity edited immediately before leaving SmartInput to verify beforeLeave persistence.
methodology.appUsable: From captured trusted click timestamp to the first painted state with the correct host route, connected/ready child adapter, hidden host loading/error, expected SmartInput row name and quantity plus enabled input/analyze controls; customer-master requires its ready bridge, completed initialization, ready status, visible header and enabled search.
methodology.clickFeedback: From captured click timestamp to a requestAnimationFrame in which the pending/active target is visible, followed by a second animation frame. A conservative paint-opportunity upper bound, not screenshot-confirmed compositor presentation.
methodology.statistics: Nearest-rank p95. Each recorded pair contains SmartInput -> customer-master -> SmartInput. No artificial source mutations, cache disabling or all-request Fetch interception are used.
methodology.commonLayer: nexusUiReadyMs is diagnostic wall time, not common-layer blocking. Optional trace is separate from KPI sampling and requires attribution review; it cannot produce a 150 ms PASS automatically.

commonLayerWarmBlocking.reason: No validated attribution of common-only synchronous intervals and gate waits. APP_READY, UI-ready wall time and total navigation are not substitutes.
